blocks.text: Day 2 · Pick-up at your hotel in San José for a journey through the Central Mountain Range on the way to Arenal. Visit an authentic Costa Rican coffee plantation to learn about the whole process, from growing and harvesting to the processing plant and roasting. Then climb towards Poás Volcano, past coffee plantations and fern, flower and strawberry farms, to see its main crater and sulphur fumaroles and learn about the park’s ecosystems. Continue to La Paz Waterfall Gardens for lunch and a trail to a spectacular waterfall in the rainforest, with the hummingbird gallery, serpentarium, aviary, butterfly garden and frog exhibit. Overnight at Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa. (B, L)

blocks.text: Day 3 · A boat tour on the Río Frío, from Los Chiles near the Nicaraguan border, in the Caño Negro Wildlife Refuge, a Ramsar wetland and one of the most diverse habitats in Costa Rica: anhingas, herons and cormorants, howler, spider and white-faced monkeys, three-toed sloths, caimans, basilisk (“Jesus Christ”) lizards and turtles. Lunch, then return to Arenal. Overnight at Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa. (B, L)
